arxiv-2011-09636.title: Robust shadow estimation
arxiv-2011-09636.creator: Senrui Chen, Wenjun Yu, Pei Zeng, Steven T. Flammia
arxiv-2011-09636.description: Abstract Efficiently estimating properties of large and strongly coupled quantum systems is a central focus in many-body physics and quantum information theory. While quantum computers promise speedups for many of these tasks, near-term devices are prone to noise that will generally reduce the accuracy of such estimates.

arxiv-2105-12133.title: Significant Dust-Obscured Star Formation in Luminous Lyman-break Galaxies at z ∼ 7 z\sim 7 -8
arxiv-2105-12133.creator: Sander Schouws, Mauro Stefanon, Rychard Bouwens, Renske Smit, Jacqueline Hodge, Ivo Labbé, Hiddo Algera, Leindert Boogaard, Stefano Carniani, Yoshinobu Fudamoto, Benne W. Holwerda, Garth D. Illingworth, Roberto Maiolino, Michael Maseda, Pascal Oesch, Paul van der Werf
arxiv-2105-12133.description: Abstract We make use of ALMA continuum observations of 15 luminous Lyman-break galaxies at z ∼ 7 z\sim 7 -8 to probe their dust-obscured star-formation. These observations are sensitive enough to probe to obscured SFRs of 20 M ⊙ M_{\odot} /yr ( 3 ​ σ 3\sigma ).

arxiv-2108-05437.title: Single Index Fréchet Regression
arxiv-2108-05437.creator: Satarupa Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2108-05437.description: Abstract July, 2023 ABSTRACT Single index models provide an effective dimension reduction tool in regression, especially for high dimensional data, by projecting a general multivariate predictor onto a direction vector. We propose a novel single-index model for regression models where metric space-valued random object responses are coupled with multivariate Euclidean predictors.

arxiv-2112-13170.title: On the Feasibility of 4.9 GHz Public Safety Band as Spectrum Option for Internet of Vehicles
arxiv-2112-13170.creator: Muhammad Faizan Rizwan Khan, Seungmo Kim, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2112-13170.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Faizan Rizwan Khan, Seungmo Kim, Senior Member, IEEE. There is an unprecedented impetus on the advancement of internet of vehicles (IoV). The vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication is well acknowledged as the key technology in constitution of the IoV. Nevertheless, the spectrum for V2X communication is undergoing a massive change in the United States: a majority of the bandwidth has been reallocated to Wi-Fi leaving even less than a half of the bandwidth for V2X.

arxiv-2201-08335.title: 60 Microlensing Events from the Three Years of Zwicky Transient Facility Phase One
arxiv-2201-08335.creator: Michael S. Medford, Natasha S. Abrams, Jessica R. Lu, Peter Nugent, Casey Y. Lam
arxiv-2201-08335.description: Abstract Microlensing events have historically been discovered throughout the Galactic bulge and plane by surveys designed solely for that purpose. We conduct the first multi-year search for microlensing events on the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF), an all-sky optical synoptic survey that observes the entire visible Northern sky every few nights.

arxiv-2205-14536.title: Configurational microcanonical statistical mechanics from Riemannian geometry of equipotenital level sets
arxiv-2205-14536.creator: Matteo Gori
arxiv-2205-14536.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matteo Gori. In the present work, we present a detailed discussion of a Riemannian metric structure originally introduced in [Gori et al., J. , 9 093204 (2018)] on the configuration space and on phase space allowing to interpret the derivatives of the configurational microcanonical entropy and of the canonical entropy in terms of integrals of extrinsic geoemtrical quantities associated to the equipotential level sets.

arxiv-2207-13078.title: Resolving the core of R136 in the optical Facilities: Gemini
arxiv-2207-13078.creator: Venu M. Kalari, Elliott P. Horch, Ricardo Salinas, Jorick S. Vink, Morten Andersen, Joachim M. Bestenlehner, Monica Rubio
arxiv-2207-13078.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Venu M. Kalari, Elliott P. Horch, Ricardo Salinas, Jorick S. Vink, Morten Andersen, Joachim M. Bestenlehner, Monica Rubio. The sharpest optical images of the R136 cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud are presented, allowing for the first time to resolve members of the central core, including R136a1, the most massive star known. These data were taken using the Gemini speckle imager Zorro in medium-band filters with effective wavelengths similar to BVRI achieving angular resolutions between 30–40 mas .

arxiv-2304-06643.title: SALSA: A Sequential Alternating Least Squares Approximation Method For MIMO Channel Estimation
arxiv-2304-06643.creator: Sepideh Gherekhloo, Khaled Ardah, Martin Haardt
arxiv-2304-06643.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sepideh Gherekhloo, Khaled Ardah, Martin Haardt. In this paper, we consider the channel estimation problem in sub-6 GHz uplink wideband MIMO-OFDM communication systems, where a user equipment with a fully-digital beamforming structure is communicating with a base station having a hybrid analog-digital beamforming structure. A novel channel estimation method called Sequential Alternating Least Squares Approximation (SALSA) is proposed by exploiting a hidden tensor structure in the uplink measurement matrix.

arxiv-2401-06599.title: Demonstration of dual Shapiro steps in small Josephson junction
arxiv-2401-06599.creator: Fabian Kaap, Christoph Kissling, Victor Gaydamachenko, Lukas Grünhaupt, Sergey Lotkhov
arxiv-2401-06599.description: Abstract Bloch oscillations in small Josephson junctions were predicted theoretically as the quantum dual to Josephson oscillations. A significant consequence of this prediction is the emergence of quantized current steps, so-called dual Shapiro steps, when synchronizing Bloch oscillations to an external microwave signal.

arxiv-2404-10852.title: Asymmetries in invisible Dark Matter mediator production associated with t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} final states
arxiv-2404-10852.creator: E. Chalbaud 1, Rui M. Silva 1,2, António Onofre 1,2, Ricardo Gonçalo 1, Miguel C. N. Fiolhais 1,3,4
arxiv-2404-10852.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by E. Chalbaud 1, Rui M. Silva 1,2, António Onofre 1,2, Ricardo Gonçalo 1, Miguel C. N. Fiolhais 1,3,4. In this paper, we propose two sets of different CP-sensitive observables inspired by the Higgs production in association with the top quark. We employ a Dark Matter simplified model that couples a scalar mediator with top quarks.

arxiv-2405-06726.title: Region of Attraction Estimation for Free-Floating Systems under Time-Varying LQR Control
arxiv-2405-06726.description: Abstract Future Active Debris Removal (ADR) and On Orbit Servicing (OOS) missions demand for elaborate closed loop controllers. Feasible control architectures should take into consideration the inherent coupling of the free floating dynamics and the kinematics of the system. Recently, Time-Varying Linear Quadratic Regulators (TVLQR) have been used to stabilize underactuated systems that exhibit a similar kinodynamic coupling.

arxiv-2412-12037.title: Rate-Splitting Multiple Access for Integrated Sensing and Communications: A First Experimental Study
arxiv-2412-12037.creator: Xinze Lyu, Sundar Aditya, Bruno Clerckx
arxiv-2412-12037.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinze Lyu, Sundar Aditya, Bruno Clerckx. A canonical use case of Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) in multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems involves a multi-antenna transmitter communicating with K K users and sensing targets in its vicinity. For this setup, precoder and multiple access designs are of utmost importance, as the limited transmit power budget must be efficiently directed towards the desired directions (users and targets) to maximize both communications and sensing performance.

arxiv-2507-18551.title: A 3D Cross-modal Keypoint Descriptor for MR-US Matching and Registration
arxiv-2507-18551.creator: Daniil Morozov, Reuben Dorent, Nazim Haouchine
arxiv-2507-18551.description: Abstract Intraoperative registration of real-time ultrasound (iUS) to preoperative Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) remains an unsolved problem due to severe modality-specific differences in appearance, resolution, and field-of-view. To address this, we propose a novel 3D cross-modal keypoint descriptor for MRI–iUS matching and registration. Our approach employs a patient-specific matching-by-synthesis approach, generating synthetic iUS volumes from preoperative MRI.

arxiv-2508-02128.title: Amber Pruner: Leveraging N:M Activation Sparsity for Efficient Prefill in Large Language Models Thanks: Corresponding author: antai2018@ia.ac.cn.
arxiv-2508-02128.creator: Pengcheng Xie, Sheng Chang, Yiwu Yao, Gongyi Wang
arxiv-2508-02128.description: Abstract In the era of large language models (LLMs), N:M sparsity has emerged as a structured compression technique critical for accelerating inference. While prior work has primarily focused on weight sparsity, it often suffers from significant accuracy degradation. Activation sparsity, though promising, is typically training-dependent and faces challenges in generalization.

arxiv-2509-01195.title: Semileptonic Ω b ∗ ⁣ − → Ω c ∗ 0 ​ ℓ ​ ν ¯ ℓ \Omega_{b}^{*-}\rightarrow\Omega_{c}^{*0}\ \ell\ \bar{\nu}_{\ell} transition in QCD
arxiv-2509-01195.creator: A. Amiri 1 , P. Eslami 1 , K. Azizi 2,3 , R. Jafari 2
arxiv-2509-01195.description: Abstract We employ the QCD sum rule method to study the semileptonic weak decay of the single bottom baryon Ω b ∗ ⁣ − \Omega_{b}^{*-} with spin 3 2 \frac{3}{2} into the single charmed baryon Ω c ∗ 0 \Omega_{c}^{*0} with spin 3 2 \frac{3}{2} , corresponding to a 3 2 → 3 2 \frac{3}{2}\rightarrow\frac{3}{2} weak transition.

arxiv-2601-12695.title: From Noise to Knowledge: System Identification with Systematic Polytope Construction via Cyclic Reformulation
arxiv-2601-12695.creator: Hiroshi Okajima, Shun Shirahama, Tatsunori Hayashi, Nobutomo Matsunaga
arxiv-2601-12695.description: Abstract Model-based control requires accurate mathematical models to guarantee control performance and stability. However, obtaining accurate models is challenging due to process and sensor noise. This paper proposes a novel identification algorithm that derives polytopic uncertainty models by interpreting noise-induced parameter fluctuations as intrinsic uncertainty.

arxiv-2602-07395.title: Haptically Experienced Animacy Facilitates Emotion Regulation: A Theory-Driven Investigation
arxiv-2602-07395.creator: Preeti Vyas, Bereket Guta, Tim G. Zhou, Noor Naila Himam, Andero Uusberg, Karon E. MacLean
arxiv-2602-07395.description: Abstract Emotion regulation (ER) is essential to mental well-being but often difficult to access, especially in high-intensity moments or for individuals with clinical vulnerabilities. While existing technology-based ER tools offer value, they typically rely on self-reflection (e.g., emotion tracking, journaling) or co-regulation through verbal modalities (reminders, text-based conversational tools), which may not be accessible or effective when most needed.

pmc-11477227.title: The 419th Aspartic Acid of Neural Membrane Protein Enolase 2 Is a Key Residue Involved in the Axonal Growth of Motor Neurons Mediated by Interaction between Enolase 2 Receptor and Extracellular Pgk1 Ligand
pmc-11477227.creator: Bing-Chang Lee, Jui-Che Tsai, Yi-Hsin Huang, Chun-Cheng Wang, Hung-Chieh Lee, Huai-Jen Tsai, Theologos Michaelidis
pmc-11477227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Neuron-specific Enolase 2 (Eno2) is an isozyme primarily distributed in the central and peripheral nervous systems and neuroendocrine cells. It promotes neuronal survival, differentiation, and axonal regeneration. Recent studies have shown that Eno2 localized on the cell membrane of motor neurons acts as a receptor for extracellular phosphoglycerate kinase 1 (ePgk1), which is secreted by muscle cells and promotes the neurite outgrowth of motor neurons (NOMN). However, interaction between Eno1, another isozyme of Enolase, and ePgk1 failed to return the same result.

pmc-11589179.title: Validation of non-destructive morphology-based selection of cerebral cortical organoids by paired morphological and single-cell RNA-seq analyses
pmc-11589179.creator: Megumi Ikeda, Daisuke Doi, Hayao Ebise, Yuki Ozaki, Misaki Fujii, Tetsuhiro Kikuchi, Kenji Yoshida, Jun Takahashi
pmc-11589179.description: SummaryOrganoids, self-organized cell aggregates, contribute significantly to developing disease models and cell-based therapies. Organoid-to-organoid variations, however, are inevitable despite the use of the latest differentiation protocols. Here, we focused on the morphology of organoids formed in a cerebral organoid differentiation culture and assessed their cellular compositions by single-cell RNA sequencing analysis.

pmc-13383137.description: Dendrobium officinale is a well-known traditional Chinese medicinal plant in Orchidaceae, and cadmium (Cd) toxicity in the substrate of continuous cultivation has become an important factor limiting cultivation of D. officinale domesticated seedling. Glutathione S-transferase (GSTs) are well-characterized as crucial mediators of plant stress responses.

pmc-13425011.title: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease and Reflux-like Phenotypes: Using Lyon Consensus 2.0 to Guide Clinical Approach
pmc-13425011.creator: Matthew K Schroeder, C Prakash Gyawali
pmc-13425011.description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is common worldwide, but troublesome symptoms alone are not sufficient for a conclusive diagnosis. The Montreal Consensus introduced a symptom-based definition of GERD and defined mucosal injury phenotypes of the disease. The Lyon Consensus adapted mucosal injury findings as well as defined abnormal reflux burden criteria for the diagnosis of conclusive GERD.

pmc-13570326.title: Fatal Intracardiac Embolism Following Cement‐Augmented Pedicle Screw Instrumentation: A Case Report
pmc-13570326.creator: Raul Eduardo Reyes Toledo, Laura Catalina Arcos, Jorge Alberto Carrillo, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13570326.description: BackgroundCement‐augmented pedicle screw instrumentation (CAPSI) is a widely used surgical technique for spinal stabilization and decompression, particularly in patients with poor bone quality. Although generally considered safe, cement extravasation can result in severe complications, including neurological injury and embolic events involving pulmonary or cardiac structures. Intracardiac cement embolism is a rare but potentially fatal occurrence.
